h:
我尝试以以下自定义节点为中心的简单工作流程：

  • comfyui-inpaint-节点

  • ComfyUI-YoloWorld-EfficientSAM

  • ComfyUI-Inpaint-CropAndStitch

如果自动屏蔽结果有更多不足之处，可以手动校正分割结果。

裁剪和缝合允许将修复区域优雅地放大到 SDXL 最佳分辨率进行采样，然后将其混合回原始图像。

请注意，由于只有遮罩区域经过去噪，因此其颜色并不总是与完整的原始图像完全匹配。通过另一个低噪采样器传递图像或使用后处理自定义节点/外部图像编辑可能会有所帮助。对于极端情况，可以使用图像协调技术，尽管我个人从未需要这样做。

我建议使用ComfyUI管理器用于安装和更新工作流程中使用的任何其他自定义节点。

o.en:
My attempt at a straightforward workflow centered on the following custom nodes:

  • comfyui-inpaint-nodes

  • ComfyUI-YoloWorld-EfficientSAM

  • ComfyUI-Inpaint-CropAndStitch

Segmentation results can be manually corrected if automatic masking result leaves more to be desired.

Crop & Stitch allows for inpainted area to be gracefully upscaled to SDXL optimal resolutions for sampling which is then blended back into the original image.

Note that because only the masked region undergoes denoising, its color will not always exactly match the full original image. Passing the image through another sampler on low denoise or using post-processing custom nodes/external image editing may help. For extreme cases image harmonization techniques could be used, though I have personally never needed to.

I'd recommend usingComfyUI-Managerfor installing and updating any other custom nodes used within the workflow.
